summary: Copart filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of ACV Auctions via a two-step tender offer and back-end merger. Merger Sub's offer of $10.50 per share in cash, launched September 17, 2026, expired October 15 with 116,818,409 shares validly tendered and not withdrawn—approximately 68.43% of outstanding ACV stock, satisfying the majority condition and all other offer conditions. Merger Sub accepted and paid for tendered shares, and the remaining merger conditions were satisfied on October 16, 2026, completing the transaction under DGCL Section 251(h). Watchers should monitor the short-form merger process, final equity value, and delisting of ACV shares.
